name: tech-store
description: TechStore: phone and laptop e-commerce (NestJS + SQL Server + React)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec sqlserver bash /database/run-sql.sh schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec sqlserver bash /database/run-sql.sh seed.sql
scripts.db:promote-admin: docker compose exec sqlserver bash /database/run-sql.sh promote-admin.sql
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
